remarks: Sleek 1 bed/1 bath residence at 100 East, Cos Cob's new boutique luxury building. This bright second-floor home features an open living area with wide-plank herringbone flooring, matte-black windows, and a gourmet kitchen with quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, and premium appliances. The spacious bedroom includes a walk-in closet, and the bath is finished with designer tile and brass fixtures. Building amenities include a 3,000 sq ft rooftop deck with cooking station, covered garage with EV charging, and private storage. Minutes to the train, parks, markets, and Greenwich Avenue.
